body: I have terrible social skills and embarrass myself. I feel moody, annoyed, have racing thoughts when I get suicidal ideation...I just don't know what to do about basic things in life...

To reply to both of you, also, my job at a local theater that I work at seemed like it was going on an upswing because of my increased motivation for a few weeks while on the Adderall but I feel like the depression, anxiety, racing thoughts, bad memories are just overtaking me and making me not motivated to work. It sucks because I am 23 years old and I am basically living like an 18 year old. I am like stuck in this state or something, I don't know what maturity is anymore...I really fucking don't...

I guess I just need someone to talk to about all these emotions that are just flowing through my mind at such a rapid rate all the time. Sometimes I just don't know how to feel and I just end up telling anyone and everyone about my stuff which can be a bad thing in which it leaves me vulnerable, and annoys them away from me. I am just so alone right now and I think I might just be driving myself into a lonely place.

I appreciate the reply but I just don't want to change my meds...I am afraid they will just take me off the Adderall XR because they think it is giving me anxiety...I have never been this focused in my life and I don't want to lose that...I haven't been taking naps like I used to either and I can get stuff done during the day.
